independent_source_findings.finding: Strict type equality is intentional and remains required.
independent_source_findings.detail: The predicates compare exact Python types before recursively comparing dictionary keys, list lengths/elements and scalar values. Numeric coercion or tolerance would alter the admitted protocol.

independent_source_findings.finding: Both fixture controls serializers explicitly emit the same complete fields.
independent_source_findings.detail: Drawbars, selected banks, route booleans, pedal values and fixed-registration enums use static_cast<unsigned>. Percussion enabled is a bool under boolalpha; harmonic/volume/decay enums are explicitly unsigned.

independent_source_findings.finding: The fractional literals do not establish a rounding defect.
independent_source_findings.detail: Expression 0.625 is exactly 5/8; peak 0.125 is exactly 1/8. Both are representable in binary floating point. The records use max_digits10 and boolalpha. Without the actual emitted token, an MSVC decimal/rounding/format explanation is unsupported.

independent_source_findings.finding: The initial copied state is deliberately specified.
independent_source_findings.detail: Every drawbar bank is filled; expression, pedal drawbars, percussion and selected preset routes are explicitly assigned. Session flags/counters have member initializers; clocks, rate, peak, prepared/running and publication revision are explicitly set. The inspected fields do not supply a source-proven uninitialized-value explanation.

independent_source_findings.finding: Restore/selection/observe do not explain a platform-specific changed expected value.
independent_source_findings.detail: restore validates then copies the full snapshot. Bank selection sets the chosen bank, clears fixed mode and enables routing. observe copies a valid nonstale snapshot and its controls when no pending controls exist. The native state_for check separately compares desired/applied snapshots against its constructed expectation.

independent_source_findings.finding: Transport still requires its original binary and bounded contract.
independent_source_findings.detail: The native --case path selects _O_BINARY on Windows. Python uses byte pipes with bounded readers and requires child success/no stderr before returning payload. Typed model failure is later than JSON parsing and earlier than complete RGBA validation. No CRLF, encoding, timeout or renderer-cause repair follows from that ordering alone.

missing_evidence.why_missing: The Python readers retain native payload only in bounded memory and emit generic comparison exceptions. The normal workflow retains their report/log output, not the --case JSON header. A53 independently confirmed this against artifact retention paths. The typed failure does not expose the mismatching leaf.

prospective_diagnostic_recommendation.minimum_needed: Root may separately admit one bounded inspection of the exact case0 footage header and case46 header fixture on the intended Windows source/toolchain, retaining executable/source identities, original JSON header bytes or a lossless archive plus hashes, and the first differing JSON path with actual/expected types and bounded values.
prospective_diagnostic_recommendation.diagnostic_only_alternative: A prospectively reviewed bounded first-mismatch report can expose the leaf when the existing unchanged typed comparison fails. Keep its failure result and all predicates; no coercion, field omission, tolerance, relaxed failure handling or pass substitution.
prospective_diagnostic_recommendation.resource_contract: Preserve 20-second child limits, 5-second cleanup, existing 512-KiB header and 64-KiB stderr bounds, full stdout draining within existing caps, one frame at a time and 90-second CTest limits. Do not execute extra cases or persist unbounded raw images.
prospective_diagnostic_recommendation.next_decision: After observing the original differing leaf/token, independently review its concrete source or protocol cause and the narrow correction before editing or claiming a repaired test. A clean Linux run, native 48-case success or unrelated VST3 pass cannot replace that missing Windows observation.
